answer: The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. A state pension forecast with contribution record works as the gate: a record of contributions spanning decades. Each of 260 aliases needs its own contribution records, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the walnut signal is public, the zephyr check is automatic, and 260 aliases cost 260 times what one real agent costs, with the ferrous trail open to all.
